turns.user:
Task: Match a simple email address: non-space non-@ characters, an @, more such characters, a dot, then more.

Write a pattern that matches exactly the strings that should match.

Must match:
  'bob@example.com'
Must not match:
  'no-at.com'
turns.thinking: A structural check: two runs of non-whitespace non-@ characters joined by an '@', with a literal dot forcing the domain to have one. Pattern: [^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+

turns.instruction: Restrict it to our company: the domain must be exactly example.com.

  'bob@other.com'
turns.thinking: Only the right-hand side changes; the local part keeps its negated class. Pattern: [^\s@]+@example\.com
